subject: problem with parallel rstan using the gridExtra library (non parallel is ok)

messages.author: 4921913d659bc87b
messages.subject: problem with parallel rstan using the gridExtra library (non parallel is ok)
parts:
Hi there,

I have been having a problem running rstan for parallel chains.  I get the following error:

4 nodes produced errors; first error: namespace ‘gridExtra’ 0.9.1 is being loa
ded, but >= 2.0.0 is required

I have installed the latest gridExtra as a user (I don't have root) and stan runs fine when parallel is turned off.

I wonder if this is a known problem (I did try to look and didn't find anything).

Thanks,
David
